title: Swift 6 Actor-Isolated Task Coalescing Async Cache
description: Implement a generic Swift 6 actor-isolated AsyncCache<Key: Hashable & Sendable, Value: Sendable> that coalesces in-flight tasks to prevent thundering herd requests, propagates errors to all awaiting callers, and supports TTL-based expiration.
prompt:
You are a senior Swift 6 systems engineer. Implement a thread-safe, actor-isolated async cache with in-flight task coalescing (single-flight):

Requirements:
1. Define `actor AsyncCache<Key: Hashable & Sendable, Value: Sendable>`.
2. Method `func get(key: Key, ttlSeconds: TimeInterval = 60, loader: @Sendable @escaping () async throws -> Value) async throws -> Value`.
3. If multiple concurrent callers request the same key while a fetch is in progress, only 1 loader invocation must execute; all other callers must await the same underlying Swift Task.
4. If the loader throws an error, the error must be propagated to all awaiting callers, and the failed task must be immediately removed from the in-flight map so subsequent calls can retry.
5. Cache successful values up to `ttlSeconds`.
6. Provide full Sendable compliance and no data races.

constraints.name: actor_isolation
constraints.description: Must declare an actor named AsyncCache.
